answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 76 identities per epoch. Audits are recorded in vertex, queued in wharf, and tide publishes the wait time. A farm of 26 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 4631 identities would post 4747 proofs and burn roughly 51 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
